Why Cellxpert

What our team actually values

Four things show up in every conversation about why people stay at Cellxpert and why they recommend it to peers.

  • Real impact, real reach

    The platform you build is the one 800+ regulated iGaming and Finance operators run their partner programmes on. Every shipped capability changes how real money moves.

  • Growth that compounds

    Career development is part of how the company runs, not a perk. Senior engineers, product managers, and account managers started in much earlier roles here.

  • Regulated-market depth

    Spend your days solving problems most general SaaS companies never see: multi-brand compliance, MT4/MT5 integration, regulator-grade reporting, real-time NGR calculation.

  • A team that knows your work

    No anonymous workflows, no faceless reviews. Small, named teams with direct lines to product, support, and operators. Your work is seen by the people whose feedback matters.

Our values

The values we hire for

Four traits we look for, and the ones we build the team around.

  • Ownership

    You own your work end to end, from the first decision through to the shipped result.

  • Quality

    We hold a high bar. Reliable, tested, and built to run regulated operators’ revenue.

  • Customer focus

    Every decision traces back to a real operator problem worth solving.

  • Continuous learning

    Curiosity is the job. We learn constantly and grow the people who do it.
